FinancialTransaction.title: FinancialTransaction
FinancialTransaction.description: Monthly income or expense entry segmented by service profile (common or premium).

profileType.description: Service profile bucket: common (Servicios Comunes) or premium (Servicios Premium).

title.description: Short description or concept of the movement.

category.description: Category label such as Servicios, VPN, Insumos, or Otros.

linkedClientId.description: Optional client document ID if generated from a client payment.

ServiceClient.title: ServiceClient
ServiceClient.description: Client subscribed to a common or premium service with per-month payment tracking.

profileType.description: Service profile bucket: common or premium.

monthlyFee.description: Monthly amount to charge the client.

billingDay.description: Day of month (1-31) when payment is due.

paidMonths.description: Bounded list of YYYY-MM keys in which the client has paid.

VpnAccount.title: VpnAccount
VpnAccount.description: VPN user subscription tracking expiration date, amount to charge, payment status, and 1-day-before alert preference.

profileType.description: Service profile bucket: common or premium.

clientName.description: Person name for this VPN subscription.

clientPhone.description: Optional WhatsApp/phone number for sending expiration reminders.

expirationMillis.description: VPN expiration date in epoch milliseconds.

isPaid.description: Whether the current VPN period is paid.

notifyOneDayBefore.description: Whether to notify 1 day before expiration.

paymentPromiseMillis.description: Optional promised payment date in epoch milliseconds (0 when no active promise).

paymentPromiseNote.description: Optional note for the promised payment date.

Reseller.title: Reseller
Reseller.description: VPN reseller tracking credit quantity, unit price per credit, and calculated total value.

profileType.description: Service profile bucket: common (Servicios Comunes) or premium (Servicios Premium).

phone.description: Optional WhatsApp or contact phone number.

creditsCount.description: Number of credits held by the reseller.

expirationMillis.description: Credits billing/expiration date in epoch milliseconds (30-day cycle).

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences for WhatsApp reminder templates, business name, notification hour, and quick renewal defaults.

businessName.description: Business name or signature used in WhatsApp templates.

whatsappClientTemplate.description: Customizable WhatsApp reminder template for monthly service clients.

whatsappVpnTemplate.description: Customizable WhatsApp reminder template for VPN accounts.

defaultCountryCode.description: Optional international dialing code digits prepended to local phone numbers.

reminderHour.description: Local hour of day (0-23) when 1-day-before VPN alarms trigger.

defaultVpnDays.description: Default number of days added by quick VPN renewal (1-365).

autoRecordIncomeOnPay.description: Default toggle for automatically creating an income transaction when marking a client or VPN as paid.

RemoteAppConfig.title: RemoteAppConfig
RemoteAppConfig.description: Read-only remote live configuration published from Firebase Console for announcements, recommended WhatsApp templates, and latest published version notices.

announcementText.description: Optional live banner announcement pushed over the internet.

updateNotes.description: Release notes for latest published build.

recommendedClientTemplate.description: Optional remotely updated WhatsApp template for clients.

recommendedVpnTemplate.description: Optional remotely updated WhatsApp template for VPN accounts.

AuthorizedUser.title: AuthorizedUser
AuthorizedUser.description: Admin-managed user access record linking an authorized email, salted PBKDF2 password hash, and real-time enabled/disabled status.

email.description: Normalized lowercase authorized email matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name of the authorized person.

enabled.description: Whether this user is currently permitted to use the application.

passwordHash.description: Hex-encoded PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hash of the access password.

passwordVersion.description: Monotonically increasing version bumped on password reset to require re-verification.

boundUid.description: Firebase Auth UID bound when the invited user signs in.

lastAccessAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last verified access.

createdBy.description: Admin Firebase Auth UID who created this record.

AdminSupportContact.title: AdminSupportContact
AdminSupportContact.description: Admin-managed WhatsApp phone number readable by signed-in users (including disabled users) so they can contact the admin from the access gate.

whatsappPhone.description: Admin WhatsApp phone number with country code.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: User-owned monthly income and expense records.

/users/{userId}/clients/{clientId}.description: User-owned service clients and monthly payment status.

/users/{userId}/vpnAccounts/{vpnId}.description: User-owned VPN accounts with expiration dates, charges, and 1-day-before reminder toggle.

/users/{userId}/resellers/{resellerId}.description: User-owned VPN resellers tracking credits count, price per credit, and total value.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User-owned configuration for WhatsApp message templates, alert schedule, and defaults.

/appConfig/public.description: Admin-managed remote live config readable by active authorized users for OTA announcements, template updates, and release metadata.

/appConfig/support.description: Admin-managed WhatsApp contact number readable by signed-in users on the disabled/unauthorized lock screen.

/authorizedUsers/{emailId}.description: Admin-managed authorized users allowlist and real-time kill switch (enabled/disabled).
